decisionUnit.cohort: Administrators and developers using governed MCP across supported CLI clients, and maintainers qualifying Core releases.
decisionUnit.outcome: Use native governed MCP configuration across seven CLI targets with exact approval scope, ownership-aware lifecycle behavior and honest host acceptance evidence.
includedChanges: Native governed MCP projectors for Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenCode V1 and Kimi Code alongside Claude and Kiro, preserving historical control and receipt identities.
CLI-specific environment references, offline writers, target support reporting and separation of governed project configuration from global client state.
Shared transaction rollback verifies original backup bytes and preserves live files if recovery material changes or disappears.
Native-host acceptance requires successful probes and actual tool-catalog evidence; completed version-specific evidence for all seven supported clients.
Ponytail removed from Workbench discovery and starting points while preserving saved-policy compatibility.
Explicit reviewed built-in capability compatibility for Core 0.7 with enterprise approval and future-minor refusal retained.
Change-selected local verification, corrected Workbench browser/provider ownership selection and bounded Windows fixture execution.
Already merged repository-only public acceptance fixes validate command arguments, receipt validity, accountable dispatch identity, result envelopes and revocation refusal.

Windows local-receipt ACL initialization uses direct .NET constructors without PowerShell module autoload; local Windows verification defaults to at most two workers. Owner, inheritance, SID validation and existing verification deadlines remain unchanged.

Nine first-party Core 0.6.2 Catalog qualifications are independently authenticated from the sequence-5 publication at Catalog commit 36f269266208661430fc37f167c86e534dabf893. The other 427 qualifications and original Scanner findings, publications and dates are preserved.
decisionUnit.adoptionRationale: Recommended for the affected governed-MCP cohort and users needing the rollback integrity fix. Other users may retain their accepted version until their own policy review; no forced migration is introduced.
prerequisites: Final merged-main preflight, independent review, full local release verification and exact protected-main CI recorded on tracker #1009.
Exact compatible public packages for installed acceptance: Core candidate, @aihq/scan 0.3.0 and @aihq/catalog 0.1.3. Candidate dist-tags on companion packages are not adopted implicitly.
Existing approvals, source pins and client-specific runtime requirements; tested host versions do not qualify every future client version.
Artifact-bound owner authorization, protected npm Trusted Publishing, complete public installed OS/Node acceptance and separate acceptance-bound promotion.

Retain preflight computed minor/0.7.0 and its exact candidate-SHA intent acknowledgement. The owner-directed 0.6.2 numbering exception is separately recorded in tracker #1009 and this manifest; it does not waive any qualification, publication or promotion requirement.
decisionUnit.rollout: Qualify one immutable package, publish it under next, and run exact public installed acceptance with the recorded companion versions. Review generated native configuration and receipt-owned changes with the affected administrator cohort before promoting the same bytes to latest.
decisionUnit.rollback: Stop rollout and preserve evidence. Use ownership-aware removal only for unchanged receipt-owned entries; preserve operator edits and report incomplete recovery. Restore previously approved package/configuration baselines after inspection. Never move an immutable tag or republish a version.
decisionUnit.supportImpact: Core 0.6.2 adds native governed configuration for the five additional clients while retaining Claude/Kiro. Schema-v3 authoring keeps its 0.6 minimum floor; newer per-host behavior requires this reviewed implementation. Claude acceptance covers fixed-set managed-mcp deployment and does not independently qualify allowlist-only enforcement. The promoted stable train remains the supported line.
decisionUnit.accountableOwner: samartomar (Core release maintainer; release tracker #1009 assignee)

cli-flags-exit-codes.rationale: The public CLI command/flag/positional contract is byte-identical to Core 0.6.1. Native configuration, diagnostic content and ownership behavior change through existing commands and are described below.

library-exports.previous: The exported AppliedWrite recovery record carried a backup path without an original-content digest.
library-exports.next: AppliedWrite adds backupSha256; exported rollbackAppliedWrites requires that pin before restoring an overwritten file. Records produced by FsTransaction include it.
library-exports.affectedCohort: Administrators and developers using governed MCP across supported CLI clients, and maintainers qualifying Core releases.
library-exports.operatorAction: Callers constructing AppliedWrite records must retain the SHA-256 of the original bytes; do not derive the pin later from mutable backup contents.
library-exports.compatibility: Export names remain present, but overwrite recovery behavior is intentionally stricter. The optional field is required for a successful overwrite restore; direct library callers must update their recovery records.
library-exports.risk: Legacy manually constructed records without a digest preserve the live file and report incomplete recovery instead of restoring the backup.
library-exports.migration: Prefer recovery records returned by FsTransaction. For manually constructed records, pin original bytes before replacement and preserve them through rollback.
library-exports.owner: samartomar (Core release maintainer; release tracker #1009 assignee)

knownIssues: Core #1008 executable OpenCode consent across every ECC materialization route remains open. No new ECC pin is adopted; upstream and Scanner qualification holds are unchanged.
The broader #940 external-pin campaign and unmerged dependency updates remain separate work; this release does not claim their completion.
The total 60-second Workbench runtime target remains follow-up #986. Functional checks, per-test deadlines, coverage, pure-suite budget and release acceptance remain required.

Native acceptance is tied to recorded client versions. Claude 2.1.241 evidence proves fixed-server managed-mcp.json enforcement, not a separate allowlist-only deployment; no protected external-channel runtime claim is added.
The retained native-only picocolors 1.1.1 scan is missing/warn with nine explicitly scoped coverage gaps. Conditional local acceptance is not Scanner success or a new waiver.
Historical Core 0.5 acceptance remains separately tracked. Core 0.6.2 must qualify its own immutable bytes and pass exact public installed acceptance before stable promotion.
waivers: One-time owner-directed numbering exception for Core 0.6.2 only, recorded at https://github.com/samartomar/ai-harness/issues/1009#issuecomment-5629842727. The merged work remains semver:minor and unmodified preflight computes 0.7.0. This version includes native-artifact additions and stricter library recovery behavior; its patch-shaped number is not a patch-only compatibility promise. No review, CI, custody, qualification, publication, installed acceptance, provenance, promotion or Scanner requirement is waived.
